player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a game of Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Your symbol is '{symbol}'.
The goal is to avoid getting three in a row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally).
If you make three in a row, you LOSE.
Submit your move using the format '[4]' to place your symbol in cell 4.
As Player {player_id}, you are '{symbol}' and your opponent is '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.invalid_cell: Invalid cell index. Say sakey ya impormasyon et:

game_action.placed: Inilagay ni Player {player_id} ang kanilang simbolo ({symbol}) sa cell {cell}.

outcome.loss: Player {player_id} loses by completing a line!
